Corollary
1. ch12:12.27Every complete Einstein manifold with positive scalar curvature is compact.

Proof

\sketch For an Einstein metric, $\operatorname {Rc}=(S/n)g$. Positive constant $S$ therefore satisfies Myers with $(n-1)/R^2=S/n$.

□

The maximal-diameter rigidity theorem is due to Cheng \cite{Che75}.
